xc_files.name: engines.main.xc
dash.main.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
shutdown
	output_number(3, 17, 0)
	output_number(1, 0, 0)
	output_text(3, 34, "")
	output_text(3, 30, "")
	output_text(3, 35, "")
	output_text(3, 33, "")
	output_text(3, 31, "")
	output_text(3, 32, "")
	output_number(3, 18, 0)
	output_number(3, 19, 0)
	output_number(3, 20, 0)
	output_number(3, 21, 0)
	output_number(3, 22, 0)
	output_number(3, 23, 0)
	output_number(3, 24, 0)
	output_number(3, 25, 0)
	output_number(3, 26, 0)
	output_number(3, 27, 0)
	output_number(3, 28, 0)
	output_number(3, 29, 0)
	output_number("gyro-*", 0, 0)
	output_number("pump-*", 0, 0)
	output_number("ignition-*", 0, 0)

update
	; Master Switch
	var $master = input_number(3, 0)
	output_number(3, 17, $master)
	
	; NavInstrument Relay
	output_number(1, 0, $master)

	; Batt
	var $battLeftVolts = round(input_number("batt-left", 0))
	var $battLeftPct = round(input_number("batt-left", 2) * 100)
	output_text(3, 34, $battLeftVolts:text)
	output_text(3, 30, $battLeftPct:text)
	var $battRightVolts = round(input_number("batt-right", 0))
	var $battRightPct = round(input_number("batt-right", 2) * 100)
	output_text(3, 35, $battRightVolts:text)
	output_text(3, 33, $battRightPct:text)
	
	; Lox/Fuel
	if $master
		var $lox = round(input_number("lox", 0)*100)
		var $fuel = round(input_number("fuel", 0)*100)
		output_text(3, 31, $lox:text)
		output_text(3, 32, $fuel:text)
	else
		output_text(3, 31, "")
		output_text(3, 32, "")
		
	; Gyros
	var $gyro1 = input_number(3, 1) * $master
	var $gyro2 = input_number(3, 2) * $master
	var $gyro3 = input_number(3, 3) * $master
	var $gyro4 = input_number(3, 4) * $master
	output_number(3, 18, $gyro1)
	output_number("gyro-pitch", 0, $gyro1)
	output_number(3, 19, $gyro2)
	output_number("gyro-roll", 0, $gyro2)
	output_number(3, 20, $gyro3)
	output_number("gyro-yaw-right", 0, $gyro3)
	output_number(3, 21, $gyro4)
	output_number("gyro-yaw-left", 0, $gyro4)
	
	; Ignition
	var $ignition1 = input_number(3, 5) * $master
	var $ignition2 = input_number(3, 6) * $master
	var $ignition3 = input_number(3, 7) * $master
	var $ignition4 = input_number(3, 8) * $master
	output_number("ignition-front-left", 0, $ignition1)
	output_number("ignition-front-right", 0, $ignition2)
	output_number("ignition-back-left", 0, $ignition3)
	output_number("ignition-back-right", 0, $ignition4)
	
	; Pumps
	var $loxPump = input_number(3, 10) * $master
	var $fuelPump = input_number(3, 11) * $master
	output_number("pump-lox", 0, $loxPump * 0.4)
	output_number("pump-fuel", 0, $fuelPump * 0.5)
	
	; Thrusters
	var $thruster1_burn = input_number("ignition-front-left", 1) > 0.01
	var $thruster1_unburnt = input_number("ignition-front-left", 2) > 0.01 or ($ignition1 and $thruster1_burn < 0.01)
	var $thruster2_burn = input_number("ignition-front-right", 1) > 0.01
	var $thruster2_unburnt = input_number("ignition-front-right", 2) > 0.01 or ($ignition2 and $thruster2_burn < 0.01)
	var $thruster3_burn = input_number("ignition-back-left", 1) > 0.01
	var $thruster3_unburnt = input_number("ignition-back-left", 2) > 0.01 or ($ignition3 and $thruster3_burn < 0.01)
	var $thruster4_burn = input_number("ignition-back-right", 1) > 0.01
	var $thruster4_unburnt = input_number("ignition-back-right", 2) > 0.01 or ($ignition4 and $thruster4_burn < 0.01)
	output_number(3, 22, $thruster1_unburnt)
	output_number(3, 23, $thruster2_unburnt)
	output_number(3, 24, $thruster3_unburnt)
	output_number(3, 25, $thruster4_unburnt)
	output_number(3, 26, $thruster1_burn)
	output_number(3, 27, $thruster2_burn)
	output_number(3, 28, $thruster3_burn)
	output_number(3, 29, $thruster4_burn)
